summary: Production-quality workflow and scripts with solid PowerShell practices (Set-StrictMode, error handling, proper parameter validation). YAML is well-structured (pinned refs, least-privilege, sensible triggers, job dependencies). Minor issue: `-GitHubOutput` parameter in Invoke-PRLabelAssigner.ps1 (line ~11) defaults to env var implicitly; more explicit validation would be better. Glob logic is correct and well-documented. No duplication or dead code. The 'Show resolved labels' workflow step lacks output format validation. Otherwise ship-ready.
